escena: SCENE (staged, Efeonce studio corridor at night, walking out to present the results that just came in): a Chilean growth strategist in her early thirties, dark hair tied back, wearing the navy Efeonce polo with the Efeonce lanyard around her neck, its badge card swinging and turned away, unreadable, caught mid-stride walking straight TOWARD the camera, a closed laptop in a plain azure-blue (#0375DB) sleeve held against her hip, looking straight into the lens with a determined, confident half-smile. Very low camera close to the floor, a strong low angle looking up at her, so she towers in the frame. She fills the LOWER 60% of the frame from mid-thigh up, her head sits just above the middle of the frame. A single practical vertical light strip on the right wall, visible and the brightest thing in the frame, rakes across her face and polo from the side; a rim from behind cuts her hair and shoulders from the dark and its beam crosses a thin haze BELOW the middle of the frame. The dark ceiling and bare wall above her head are calm, evenly shadowed and empty. Bare dark walls, no plants, no framed art. 24mm f/2.

lecho.objeto: a dark matte floor edge close to the lens, dissolved into blur and outside the beam

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed dark ceiling and bare wall above her head
